summary: A switch for an on/off setting, with its label, description and error beside it, taking part in forms.

label.note: Visible label next to the switch and accessible name. Required: shadow DOM keeps external <label for> from naming the inner input. Names the setting and does not change with the state.

hideLabel.note: Visually hides the label; it stays the accessible name. Use only when the row has other visible text naming the setting.

error.note: Error message. Setting it marks the field invalid and sets a customError validity.

size.note: Track 32x20px (default) or 24x16px (sm); thumb 16px or 12px. Both keep a 24px-high hit area. Label and description text do not change size.

value.note: Submitted with the form while checked; nothing is submitted while off (native checkbox semantics).

checked.note: Current on/off state. Not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset.

required.note: Native required: must be on to submit (valueMissing while off). Adds an aria-hidden asterisk after the label.

disabled.note: Native disabled; dimmed; not focusable; not submitted. A disabled <fieldset> ancestor has the same effect without changing this attribute.

anatomy.name: field
anatomy.notes: Grid: control in the first column, label, description and error in the second. Logical properties, so it mirrors in RTL.

anatomy.name: control
anatomy.notes: Hit area, at least 24px high and as wide as the track; centers the track on the label's first line.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.notes: Native <input type="checkbox" role="switch">, visually transparent and covering the control; receives focus, Space, clicks and validation.

anatomy.name: track
anatomy.notes: The pill the thumb slides in; aria-hidden decoration painted under the input. Fill changes with checked.

anatomy.name: thumb
anatomy.notes: Round knob: at the inline start when off, at the inline end when on (mirrors in RTL). Its position, not only the fill, shows the state.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.notes: Native <label for> in the same shadow root; clicking it toggles.

anatomy.name: error
anatomy.notes: Persistent polite live region; text appears when invalid.

input.note: Each toggle. Native and composed, so it crosses the shadow boundary.

change.note: Toggle committed. Re-dispatched from the host because native change is not composed (NativeControl). FormData read in a change listener already has the new value.

focus-visible.note: 3px solid ring around the track and border in ring color (a translucent ring would fall under 3:1).

checked.note: Track fills with primary and the thumb moves to the inline end.

invalid.trigger: error set, or required and off after blur or a submit attempt

disabled.trigger: disabled attribute or a disabled fieldset ancestor (:host(:disabled))
disabled.note: Track, thumb and label dimmed; not-allowed cursor.

accessibility.accessibleNameSource: The label prop, through a native <label for> in the same shadow root.

formAssociation.note: NativeControl(FormAssociated(LitElement)), as Checkbox (ElementInternals). formValue(): value while checked, null while off. formReset(): checked returns to the checked attribute (default). formStateRestore(state): checked = state is not null. validationAnchor(): the inner input, so required gives the native valueMissing message and reportValidity() focuses it. A disabled fieldset ancestor disables it through isDisabled without touching the disabled attribute; disabled is not submitted. <label for=host-id> outside clicks the host, forwarded to the input.

accessibility.targetSize: The control hit area is at least 24x24px at both sizes (WCAG 2.5.8), even with hide-label; the label row is also clickable.
accessibility.focusRingVisible: On keyboard focus of the input (:state(focus-visible)); 3px ring in switch.focus-ring.color around the track.
accessibility.missingNameWarning: Dev-only console warning, once, when label is empty.

keyboard.Tab: move focus to and from the switch
keyboard.Enter: submits the form (implicit submission, SB-0009); does not toggle, like Checkbox

aria: role=switch on the native checkbox input; aria-checked is exposed natively as true/false (never mixed)
aria-describedby -> description and error ids (same root)
required: native required; the asterisk is aria-hidden
track and thumb are aria-hidden decoration
error: sets a customError validity, so the form blocks submission
announcements: state change is announced natively as on/off by the switch role
error text is announced once when it appears (persistent aria-live=polite region)

useCases.when: A single setting that is either on or off
useCases.use: sb-switch with a label naming the setting
name (and value if "on" is not the right payload); off submits nothing

antiPatterns.pattern: A label that changes with the state ("On" / "Off")
antiPatterns.why: WAI-ARIA APG switch pattern: the label must stay the same when the state changes; the role already announces on/off
antiPatterns.alternative: A fixed label naming the setting

antiPatterns.why: The switch role has no mixed value (WAI-ARIA); aria-checked=mixed is not supported on it

antiPatterns.pattern: Choosing exactly one option from several
antiPatterns.why: A switch is one independent on/off setting

drift.contract: label, description and error are props of Switch
drift.realization: shadcn composes Label/Field parts around Switch; shadow DOM requires them inside
shadcn renders a <button role=switch> with a hidden input (Radix); the native input gives Space, validity and form state for free (SB-0007)
shadcn default is 32x18.4px; the system token rounds it to the 4px grid
shadcn's hit area is the track (18.4px / 14px high), under WCAG 2.5.8 without a label
shadcn default bg-input is neutral-200; changed for WCAG 1.4.11

drift.contract: off thumb color.background, on thumb color.primary-foreground in every mode
drift.realization: shadcn dark mode uses foreground for the off thumb; no semantic token switches between them by mode, and color.background on color.input still meets 3:1
not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset

drift.contract: error prop, destructive track border, live error text
drift.realization: shadcn Switch has no invalid look of its own (aria-invalid only through Field)

openQuestions.question: Contract content drafted with the contract-author skill (visual reference, WAI-ARIA APG)?
openQuestions.recommendation: Yes, following its workflow and Checkbox as the closest template.
openQuestions.answer: Yes: contract-author workflow run in one session without its sub-agents; the visual reference's Switch (look, sizes, API) and the WAI-ARIA APG switch pattern (role, keyboard, fixed label), from the drafter's knowledge of both (not re-fetched); sizes from the system's size.switch.* tokens. Implementation not started.

openQuestions.question: Which native element carries the switch: <input type=checkbox role=switch> or <button role=switch>?
openQuestions.answer: input type=checkbox role=switch, inside FormAssociated + NativeControl. It gives Space, the valueMissing message, reportValidity focus and label activation natively, and reuses the Checkbox mixins (SB-0007: native elements first, switch named).

openQuestions.question: Does Enter toggle the switch (APG lists it as optional)?
openQuestions.recommendation: No: Enter submits the form, like Checkbox.
openQuestions.answer: No. Space toggles; Enter submits the owning form through requestSubmit (SB-0009), matching the native checkbox and sb-checkbox, so one keyboard model holds for every form control.

openQuestions.question: Is checked reflected to an attribute?
openQuestions.recommendation: No, the attribute is the reset default.
openQuestions.answer: No. The checked attribute is the default form reset restores (like native defaultChecked); the property is the current state.

openQuestions.question: What are the two sizes called and which is the default?
openQuestions.answer: size = default | sm (the visual reference's names; spec/api.json aliases them to medium | small), default "default". Only the track and thumb change; label text keeps the control font size.

openQuestions.question: Is label required, and where does it sit?
openQuestions.recommendation: Required, after the switch, with hide-label for rows that name it elsewhere.
openQuestions.answer: Required (like Checkbox and Input), in the column after the switch; hide-label keeps it as the accessible name.

openQuestions.question: How does the switch meet WCAG 2.5.8 when the label is hidden, given the 20px and 16px tracks?
openQuestions.recommendation: A 24px-minimum hit area around the track.
openQuestions.answer: The control part is at least 24px high (switch.hit-area = size.control.xs) and the input covers it, so the target holds at both sizes without the label. Recorded as drift.

openQuestions.question: What does required mean for a switch?
openQuestions.recommendation: Must be on, as on a native checkbox.
openQuestions.answer: Must be on: native required on the inner checkbox gives valueMissing while off. Invalid look shows after blur or a submit attempt, like Checkbox.

openQuestions.question: Support readonly or a loading state?
openQuestions.answer: No. A native checkbox ignores readonly, and neither is in the reference; add later by a new decision if a product needs it.
